title: A host finalizer retains a statement handle after Close and passes the same dangling handle to sqlite3_finalize a second time.
live_note: The defect is in the binding, not in SQLite: this corpus pins no binding release, and the host arm builds the 3.53.3 amalgamation, so whether a row is live in a given binding version is not established here.

virtual-malloc.oracle: virtual profile, SQLite 3.53.3 on virtual mallocng (tools/arms.json virtual-mallocng; shared/run-virtual.py): a heap-use-after-free or bad-free row is CAUGHT by a fault in its declared fault_sites after main began, MISSED when it completes; a null-deref row is its own class and a none row is correct at exit 0, neither scored as a temporal catch (the project lead's decision, 2026-10-22)
virtual-malloc.verdict_note: cause=2 pc=0x3fa1411c00 in invalid_free; by function: invalid_free is the row's declared site (the allocator refusing the free)

vp2-malloc.oracle: virtual profile, SQLite 3.53.3 on virtual mallocng (tools/arms.json virtual-mallocng; shared/run-virtual.py): a heap-use-after-free or bad-free row is CAUGHT by a fault in its declared fault_sites after main began, MISSED when it completes; a null-deref row is its own class and a none row is correct at exit 0, neither scored as a temporal catch (the project lead's decision, 2026-10-22)

status: host ASan arm recorded, oracle 'bad-free'; NOTE.md records why it is not reproduced
fault_sites_why: bad-free: host ASan reports the second free in free() under sqlite3MemFree; on the virtual profile the allocator refuses it in cap_malloc_invalid_free, which the project lead ruled a catch on 2026-10-22; invalid_free is the static function (runtime/virtual/heap.c:350) whose body is that label and its unimp, the name tools/verdicts.py's Symbols gives the same pc. Added after run 1 read the row unattributed on the name alone (README, 2026-10-22)
